reviews.text:
The clinic is very good. Very well set up. It has a separate area for cats, which is great.
I went through a lot of trouble with my puppy and received a lot of support from them.
10 out of 10. Structure and professionals, from the reception to everyone else.

The clinic is very well maintained and organized, and the service is excellent! My dog ​​and I were seen by Dr. Francini, who is a great professional! Careful and affectionate with the animals! We used the Petlove plan and everything went smoothly.
My cat Romeo is always very well received at the clinic. A pleasant environment with excellent professionals.

Dr. Fernanda, thank you so much for all the affection, care, and dedication you've shown Keko and Keka Bella. ❤️🐾 It's wonderful to know that my two loves are being cared for by someone so special and competent. Thank you for everything! 🥰🐶🐶 …
Very attentive and careful service from scheduling to consultations and procedures.

Goten was experiencing severe shortness of breath, and the prompt care with day hospitalization was essential for his recovery. In three days, he already shows a 70% improvement, as he continues treatment at home.
Prompt care, speed, and competence were essential for this recovery.
We are immensely grateful.
When you prioritize, the results tend to be a success. Congratulations to the Petiva team.
